When on:
1. Antifilter IPs → VPN.
2. Other Russian IPs → direct.
3. Everything else → VPN.

Antifilter takes priority if lists overlap.
When off: all destinations use the VPN.
Lists update automatically about every 12 hours. Failed updates keep the last valid copy. Routing changes may briefly interrupt connections.

Each connection uses one server. Existing connections cannot move between servers; apps must retry interrupted requests. Servers can have different exit IPs. Initial checks take several seconds. Traffic totals include health checks and do not indicate server health.

The subscription is encrypted with Android Keystore. No subscription key is built into this APK. VPN-routed traffic is blocked if all servers are unavailable. Smart routing allows Russian IPs to connect directly. For protection if Android stops the app, enable “Block connections without VPN” in Android VPN settings.
Pool size: %1$d · rotation and health checks

RR VPN uses AndroidLibXrayLite (LGPL-3.0) and Xray-core (MPL-2.0).
